say:1:1029755001:1.text: That rascal Hugin told me the Mithril Consortium and <style="stress"><player_name></style> are setting up a big business deal.
say:1:1029755001:1.source_cn: 我是听呼金那小子说，秘银商会和<style=stres...
say:1:1029755001:1.male: That rascal Hugin told me the Mithril Consortium and <style="stress"><player_name></style> are setting up a big business deal.
say:1:1029755001:1.female: That rascal Hugin told me the Mithril Consortium and <style="stress"><player_name></style> are setting up a big business deal.

say:2:1029755002:0.text: You're not planning to leave Brimstone Village out of it, are you?
say:2:1029755002:0.source_cn: 这种事可少不了我们深岩村吧？

choice_prompt:3:1029755002.text: You're not planning to leave Brimstone Village out of it, are you?
choice_prompt:3:1029755002.source_cn: 这种事可少不了我们深岩村吧？

say:4:1029755003:0.text: When it comes to trade, we've already signed some preliminary agreements with Lightbearer territories. Special ores, mass-produced goods...
say:4:1029755003:0.source_cn: 要说通商，之前深岩村已经重新与耀光各地签了初步合作的契...

say:5:1029755004:1.text: But Hugin said your plan this time is something completely new!
say:5:1029755004:1.source_cn: 但我听呼金说，这次你们到处在忙的那什么合作方式不一样！

say:6:1029755005:1.text: Local goods flowing everywhere, travelers going place to place... just hearing about it got me fired up!
say:6:1029755005:1.source_cn: 又有各地的特产往来，又有旅客可以到处游玩，我一听就心动了！

say:7:1029755006:1.text: Our village has got things it wants to buy too, and hey, I like to get out and explore now and then!
say:7:1029755006:1.source_cn: 深岩村那边也有想采购的东西，更何况我自己也偶尔想出门逛逛嘛！

say:8:1029755007:1.text: So once I heard the news, I rushed straight over.
say:8:1029755007:1.source_cn: 所以我听到消息第一时间就跑来了。

say:9:1029755008:1.text: It's been ages since I last visited Holistone. It doesn't seem to have changed much.
say:9:1029755008:1.source_cn: 好久没来圣石镇了，看起来这边变化也不大嘛。

say:11:1029755009:1.text: If all goes smoothly with the trade developments, Holistone might see some changes soon too.
say:11:1029755009:1.source_cn: 如果这段时间的贸易建设一切顺利，说不定圣石镇这边也会有...

say:12:1029755010:1.text: Working with Brimstone Village... not a bad idea. Even I've heard tales of the scenic beauty in Ironhold Bay.
say:12:1029755010:1.source_cn: 和深岩村合作……嗯，是个好主意，峡湾的风光连我都有所耳闻。

say:13:1029755011:1.text: And you can try our forges firsthand—forging your own weapon is the full experience!
say:13:1029755011:1.source_cn: 还能亲自体验我们的锻造生产线，亲手铸造武器！

say:15:1029755012:0.text: Zanie, it's barely been a minute and you're already pitching tourism?
say:15:1029755012:0.source_cn: 祖娅，这么点时间没见，你都会做旅游营销了啊……

say:16:1029755013:1.text: What can I say? Life's not cheap.

say:17:1029755014:0.text: So are we calling this a deal? Then I'll tell them to activate the trade station!
say:17:1029755014:0.source_cn: 所以，我们现在就算谈妥了？那我这就通知他们，启用贸易站！

choice_prompt:18:1029755014.text: So are we calling this a deal? Then I'll tell them to activate the trade station!
choice_prompt:18:1029755014.source_cn: 所以，我们现在就算谈妥了？那我这就通知他们，启用贸易站！

say:19:1029755015:1.text: Of course! In business, timing is everything. And that Hugin brat wants to sell his inventions too, doesn't he?
say:19:1029755015:1.source_cn: 当然，生意这种事就要分秒必争，更何况呼金那小子不也想着...

say:20:1029755016:1.text: We're rivals, so I have to stay one step ahead!
say:20:1029755016:1.source_cn: 我们可是竞争对手，我当然要抓紧一切可能抓住的机会！

say:21:1029755017:1.text: The trade station's based on the Cedartown model. The details might differ, but it's got even more features!
say:21:1029755017:1.source_cn: 这个贸易站就是模仿你们在雪松镇修建的那个建立的——细节...

say:22:1029755018:1.text: I'll handle route upkeep and tourist services too. As soon as you give the word, I'll get things moving.
say:22:1029755018:1.source_cn: 维护路线，照管游客这些活儿当然也归我，只要你们拍板，我...

say:23:1029755019:1.text: Whoa... Zanie doesn't waste a second when it comes to work.
say:23:1029755019:1.source_cn: 好、好厉害……祖娅做起事来真是雷厉风行……

say:24:1029755020:1.text: Let's not rush. Efficiency's great, but in trade, both sides need to evaluate each other's goods.
say:24:1029755020:1.source_cn: 别急，虽然效率至上，但这次的合作是通商往来，双方彼此的...

say:25:1029755021:1.text: Thanks to <style="stress"><player_name></style> and our earlier talks, I've gotten to know your village pretty well.
say:25:1029755021:1.male: Thanks to <style="stress"><player_name></style> and our earlier talks, I've gotten to know your village pretty well.
say:25:1029755021:1.female: Thanks to <style="stress"><player_name></style> and our earlier talks, I've gotten to know your village pretty well.

say:26:1029755022:1.text: But Zanie, you're probably not too familiar with the other parts of this region. Why don't we show you around a bit?
say:26:1029755022:1.source_cn: 但祖娅你对这附近应该不太熟悉吧？不如就在附近转转如何？

say:27:1029755023:0.text: A business tour? I'm not great at that stuff... Where would we even go?
say:27:1029755023:0.source_cn: 商务考察？我不太擅长这个……你们要去哪考察啊？

choice_prompt:28:1029755023.text: A business tour? I'm not great at that stuff... Where would we even go?
choice_prompt:28:1029755023.source_cn: 商务考察？我不太擅长这个……你们要去哪考察啊？

say:29:1029755024:0.text: Considering distance and speed, I think Ryeham would be the perfect place to start.
say:29:1029755024:0.source_cn: 嗯，考虑到距离和速度，我觉得金穗村就很适合作为第一个考察地。

say:30:1029755026:1.text: Then it's settled! I'm counting on you all!
say:30:1029755026:1.source_cn: 那就这么办吧！交给你们了！

choice:28:0:1.text: Hmm... where should we take her?
choice:28:0:1.male: Hmm... where should we take her?
choice:28:0:1.female: Hmm... where should we take her?

say:32:1029755025:0.text: Let's start with Ryeham. It's close, has distinctive goods, and we're all familiar with it.
say:32:1029755025:0.source_cn: 那就去金穗村吧，又近，货物又有特色，而且我们都很熟悉。

choice:3:0:1.text: You want in on the trade network?
choice:3:0:1.male: You want in on the trade network?
choice:3:0:1.female: You want in on the trade network?
